component.name: Mobapp Game
component.summary: Minimalist physics arcade: speed, flips, built-in editor

description.p: A cross-platform minimalist arcade game powered by Emini physics engine. Android, desktop Java, and J2ME are supported.

ul.li: Endless mode: the track is procedurally generated on the fly, randomly connecting various structures (both built-in and custom).
Levels: completely predefined tracks with obstacles, where the main goal is to reach the finish plate.

description.p: Built-in editor: The game offers complete creative freedom. You can create your own levels and structure blocks for endless mode.

Examples: The editor allows you to open the game's built-in structures and levels - they are highlighted and displayed at the end. Built-in structures can be overridden by naming a custom one with the same name (don't forget to load the structures from the main menu).
Tools for creating tracks of any difficulty:

ul.li: Surfaces: Lines, Circles (arcs with adjustable radius and scaling), and Sinusoids for smooth transitions.
Interactive Platforms: Trampolines with adjustable springiness, deadly "Lava", and "Broken Lines" (falling slabs).
Accelerators: Plates that change the engine's power and direction (can also slow down).
Physics Bodies: Round and Square physical entities. Adjust their mass, friction, elasticity, gravity, color, fall timers, or turn them into moving lava!
Auxiliary elements: Finish, Spawn points, and "Link" (copies another element with an offset).

screenshot.caption: Browsing built-in structures in the editor

description.p: This is primarily a technical and Quality-of-Life update focused on player feedback and compatibility:

ul.li: Reworked on-screen hints
Option to use a restart button instead of swipe
Resume from the main menu instead of always starting a new run
Android 1.0 support, proper rendering and better performance on ≤4.4
Support opening the game directory in the system file manager
Added SDL3 graphics backend: brings better overall performance and proper HiDPI support, paving the way for Linux Mobile
The entire game can now be operated with literally one button: navigate menus, drive, pause, and restart via multi-taps
World rendering optimizations for hi-res screens
Memory allocation optimizations (less GC stutter). This is most noticeable on iOS
Lowered minimum iOS version requirement to 8.0
Reorganized settings, so all options fit on smaller displays
Redesigned the battery indicator
Added a few new structures to world generation
Nearly twice as many structures, new levels
Reworked levels and structures to make gameplay rely more on skill than luck

description.p: New features for creating interactive mechanisms:

ul.li: Initial velocity properties, including for initially static bodies
Center of mass offset for rotation around a point
Collision layers

description.p: Build all kinds of fun things in the editor: lifts, launching traps, catapults, perpetual motion machines!

ul.li: Added CLI for generating file thumbnails for levels and structures
Added battery level indicator via oshi library
Added a setting to automatically load external structures on every game start
Cross-platform optimizations
Bug fixes
New bugs
